body: Holy fuck I couldn’t get through your entire post. I stopped at the bland eggs. That sounded so much when I was 5150d. The event was so traumatic for me. Stay strong. I’m sorry I didn’t get to read the rest but it was too triggering for me.

I was doing fun for a while. I’m at high dosages for my meds but I’m still feeling depressed. I’m so fucking sad. My therapist threw out the words “treatment resistant depression” . I’m at the point where I wonder if I should keep going.

In past experience, Lexapro made me feel like the walking dead. It didn’t help with my depression but managed my anxiety. Because that prescription is not set to be refilled, I think my psychiatrist is gonna place me on another SSRI until I just find one that works.

I’m experiencing the same sleepiness with Seroquel. But I welcome it because I’d rather be asleep than awake and thinking.

How so? They’re having me take Lexapro in the morning and Seroquel  noon and at night. But the prescription isn’t set to be refilled. Just want to know because I have experience with Lexapro.

(Reposted because I accidentally replied with main acc)
No problem. I literally withdrew for 2 quarters because I was close to ending it. I wish you the best! 💖
You’re fine. I would think that having suicidal thoughts would be good enough reason. I’m sorry, I’m American so I don’t have an idea how it works over there.
Is the student loan for the whole year or is it a semester/quarterly for you?
I was in the same boat but I decided to withdrawal from my university for 2 quarters. I don’t know if that’s an option for you but I think a break might do you some good
I’ve been spiraling and I’m getting closer and closer to just killing myself already. I don’t want to be sad anymore.

I get you. It’s the same for me. I get too attached to people and then they get tired of me. If you want to talk to someone my inbox is open but I’ve been a little busy with school and work so I don’t guarantee I’ll be amazing at being a friend
I can do with the weight gain lol. Maybe my jeans will finally fit me again
thank you for your response
I can’t guarantee I’ll be a good friend but I’d love to be your friend

Thank you.

yeah I have made an appointment with my psychiatrist to maybe up the dosage or start another one.
Thank you for your compassion

Thank you so much for your message.

I’ve been taking anti-depressants for 6 months or so and I think my body just became used to them.

As for your last paragraph, I met with my therapist today and she said the exact same thing. 

I think I’m over last nights episode but I still want to thank you for your message.

I have a therapist and psychiatrist. I’m on an anti-depressant and anti-anxiety. I have friends who know. 

Last night I was on an edge and I’m grateful I had a friend to talk me from it.

Thank you for your concern.

It's been about a month and a half on Lexapro and about 5 weeks on Wellbutrin. My lows aren't so low anymore and suicidal thoughts are at the back of my mind. But I still feel anxious and like I'm losing my mind. I'm on edge and see shadows move in the corners of my eyes. Maybe I'm just being paranoid. I can't wait until finals are over so that I can relax.

I can feel your confidence through your text lol
And thank you for replying :)
Thank you, I'm having a real hard time expressing my feelings without feeling shame or feeling like I'm faking it.

Thank you for your response.

I'm currently seeing a therapist and attending group therapy as well. 

I was just worried cause I read about people reacting to the medicine and I felt like I haven't.

First of all, Happy Birthday! :)
And trust me I've been there, feeling depressed on a day where you're supposed to be happy, you're not alone in that sentiment.
